issues: The fanfare says "Choose up to 2," so the root effect should use chooseMultiple with min 0 and max 2, not choose with min 1 and max 2.
Option 1 should target an enemy amulet on the field, but the parsed destroy effect uses enemyFieldCard and can hit followers; restrict the target to enemy amulets specifically.

The spell says "Choose one" and only becomes "Choose up to 2" with Necrocharge (10); encode a base choice of exactly 1 plus a Necrocharge (10) conditional that changes the choice count to up to 2, instead of always allowing up to 2.

The spell has an optional additional cost of discarding a Dragoncraft card that costs 7 or more; this is missing and should be encoded with an optionalCost/discardFromHand branch tied to the upgraded effect.

The parsed choose between 3 damage and 4 damage + draw is incorrect because the player does not choose the mode independently; the effect should deal 3 damage by default, or 4 damage and draw a card only if the additional cost was paid.

The granted delayed effect is wrong: the card says to give the follower "At the start of your end phase, destroy this card," but the parse grants Last Words destroy instead. It should grant a startOfEnd triggered self-destroy ability to the follower that was put onto the field. Implement an ability-granting operation for triggered abilities such as grantTriggeredAbility or grantStartOfEnd effect targeting the selected follower.

The activated ability should deal 2 damage to an enemy leader or an enemy follower, but the parsed effect only targets enemy followers. It should support a target selector that can choose either enemyLeader or enemyFollower for a single damage effect; implement a mixed target selector such as enemyLeaderOrFollower.

On Evolve says "Deal 5 damage to each follower on the field," but the parsed effect uses dealDamageAllEnemies and only damages enemy followers. It should damage all followers on both sides; encode an all-followers damage effect instead.

The condition is "if there are at least 3 cards in your EX area," but the parsed condition checks for at least 3 Puppet-trait cards in EX area. It should check total EX area card count, not trait-specific count.
